groups.label: Cupboard, larder and prepared shelf
groups.description: Banked rounds and prepared segments (pre-System-3 ready dialogue) that air without a new roll.
groups.clear_why: _PANTRY/_SHELF/_LARDER live in memory and _pantry_flush_worker/_larder_flush_worker (app.py ~42160/42415) re-save the in-memory copy over a deleted file; _cupboard_finish_load and _FINISH_QUEUE likewise. Hot road: POST /api/cache/purge {areas:[pantry,shelf,larder,takes]} drops the memory, then the files.

groups.label: Gold bars
groups.description: Rhymed lines kept to be fired again (gap filler, interject openings).
groups.clear_why: _gold_rows() memoises the file once per process (_GOLD['loaded']) and _gold_save() rewrites it from memory (app.py ~92568).

groups.label: Response bank, continuity reserve, SFX Guy speech bank
groups.description: Pre-recorded cover lines: listening responses, the emergency continuity reserve, the SFX Guy's prepared liners.
groups.clear_why: ResponseBank(_RESPONSES, app.py 1105), SfxSpeechBank(_SFX_READY_BANK, 82491) and _CONTINUITY_BANK (continuity_load, 96951) hold the rows in memory and re-save them.

groups.label: Manager memos and upstairs pages
groups.description: Memos from upstairs and the voiced pages (text + mp3) that air as the manager road's material.
groups.clear_why: Read from disk on every call (_manager_memos_read 74403, upstairs_list 74312); writers re-read before writing, so a deleted file is simply empty. In-flight chapter-shelf entries may still name a page until they expire.

groups.label: Produced adverts
groups.description: Written ad reads and their produced audio (ads_audio/).
groups.clear_why: ad_list() (63873) reads the file every call; coord_spot_ready checks the mp3 exists. A deleted file reads as no ads.

groups.label: Record intros/outros queue
groups.description: Tinted record-bound talk waiting for its record.
groups.clear_why: track_talk_load() restores into memory once (_TRACK_TALK_LOADED) and track_talk_save(force) rewrites it (45829-46031).

groups.label: Recorded calls and the call log
groups.description: The call log (1,419 calls) and the re-air road's finished call mp3s (radio_cache/calls).
groups.clear_why: _RADIO['call_log'] ring in memory; call_log_read memo keyed on mtime (103694); _call_log_write_now rewrites the file.

groups.label: System 3 chapter shelf (in-flight exchanges)
groups.description: System 3's prepared exchanges around a pre-System-3 opening (gold bar / ad read / page / station ID); <=4 h old, the loader drops non-live rows after 6 h anyway.
groups.clear_why: _s3_chapter_shelf() reads the file once per process (_S3_CHAPTER_STATE['loaded'], app.py ~36372) and _s3_chapter_save() rewrites it on every state change.

groups.label: System 2 hour plans, candidates and receipts
groups.description: System 2's running-order DB: hours/slots/jobs, 319 candidates and 2,879 reservations carrying 1,754 voice_media takes, 2,169 heard fingerprints, plus its traces and audit archives.
groups.clear_why: system2.System2Store keeps an open sqlite connection (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, system2.py 142-152); deleting under an open handle leaves the process writing to an unlinked inode.
groups.reset: absent (schema recreated by system2.py on open)

groups.label: Production queue and script manifests
groups.description: script_production's frozen rounds and manifest_store's per-revision scripts/takes/cuts (109k files).
groups.clear_why: script_production.py opens ManifestStore(data_root/'manifests') and replays rounds.jsonl; in-memory queue.

groups.label: Rendered takes (voice_media clips)
groups.description: Every voiced line on disk (voice_media/*.wav|mp3), its low-rate transcodes (voice_media/lo) and the render-replay index that re-serves an old take for identical text.
groups.clear_why: _protected_media_keys (24133) protects takes named by the pantry/banks; render_replay is memoised once (_replay_cache 25574). voice_media/sfx (levelled SFX), tapes/ and spec/ are NOT takes and are kept.

groups.label: Radio recordings cache
groups.description: radio_cache: recorded episodes, full broadcast mixes, cuts, staging, thumbnails, the music log.
groups.clear_why: Episode/broadcast welders write here continuously (_EPISODE_STAGE 75215, _bmix 160516); delete only with the station stopped. Directory skeleton kept.

groups.label: Aired-line history and repetition memory
groups.description: What aired and when: air log, airings, said lines, screenplay, script ledger, prints, picks, news said, re-air marks, running-order position.
groups.clear_why: Several are in-memory rings re-saved by their writers (recent_picks RECENT_SAVE_EVERY, line/phrase prints, said lines, coordinator _GAPS, entry ledger _ENTRY_LEDGER); the append-only jsonl ledgers (air_log, airings, script_ledger) would be recreated by the next append and are safe hot.

groups.label: SFX / H3 play history
groups.description: What the SFX Guy and the H3 hourly door played, and what he said.
groups.clear_why: sfx_history/sfx_plays/sfx_video_played are held in memory and re-saved (86681-88669); h3_hourly_used via _H3_FRESH_FILE.

groups.label: Backup and leftover files
groups.description: *.bak*, *.pre<N>*, *.prev.*, schedule_before_*, dated response-bank snapshots, write probes, orphaned *.tmp.
groups.clear_why: Nothing reads them (0 code references).

groups.label: Voice signature backups and voice trash
groups.description: voices/*/reference.wav.pre-rebuild / .bak-garble and voices_trash/: older copies of voice-actor signatures.
groups.clear_why: Nothing reads them, but they are voice-actor media (KEEP rule) - excluded by default.

groups.label: Station settings
groups.description: settings.json - every dial.
groups.clear_why: load_settings() (3251) re-reads after SETTINGS_STAT_REST; change it through save_settings / the Settings page, not by deleting the file.
groups.reset: absent -> code defaults (DEFAULT settings in load_settings)

empty_forms.note: load_settings() falls back to the code defaults

groups.label: Stored configs and switches
groups.description: Routing, workflows, hourly door, orchestrator policy, storage caps, modifiers, prompt books, personas, cast, schedule, one-word mode switches.
groups.clear_why: Mostly memoised per process; mode switches are re-read every ~3 s (hot).

groups.label: Lists and books
groups.description: Topics, callers, guests, plotlines, bans, rhyme families, crystals, quips, votes, saved banter.
groups.clear_why: Each list's desk keeps a memo; edit through its desk/System 3 LIST family.

groups.label: System 3 history
groups.description: system3.sqlite3 (conversations, lines, events, configs, settings, graph presets), origin ledger, cast airings, manager-topic history, list edits.
groups.clear_why: System3Store holds an open sqlite connection (system3_runtime.py 215); System 3 config lives INSIDE system3.sqlite3 (tables configs/settings) - reset through the System 3 config API, never by deleting the DB.

groups.label: Labs
groups.description: rejection_lab, line_review, prompt_history/learning, station_flow, rhyme_assistance, sfx_cadence, audits and benches.
groups.clear_why: Open sqlite handles; store_retention.py trims them.

groups.label: Telemetry logs
groups.description: Boot, heat, loop stalls, gaps, model calls, notifications, keeper, pause log.
groups.clear_why: Append-only; not read to make air.

groups.label: Derived caches (regenerable)
groups.description: Music transcodes, Nabu device audio, levelled SFX, tape transcodes, thumbnails, vectors, research notes.
groups.clear_why: Rebuilt on demand at CPU/GPU cost (heat).

groups.label: Libraries and media
groups.description: Music/SFX indexes, art, library, minds, manuals, voices, H3 cast, PineLive, Pine Cam, uploads, exports, speakbox vault.
groups.clear_why: Source material.

groups.label: Station state and credentials
groups.description: on/paused switches, share links, HA token, inbox, sequence counters.
groups.clear_why: Small state files.
